name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels with a draggable light line between them, turning blue while dragged or focused, with an optional small grip tab.
usage: Let people trade space between two views they use together: the playground's parameters and its result, a list and its detail. Give panels sensible minimum sizes, and add withHandle when the edge is not otherwise obvious. Arrow keys resize from the keyboard.
avoid: More than three panels in a row
Panels so small their content breaks
Resizing as the only way to reach content

reference.source: context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/playground/results.tsx (the light dividers between panes)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
